description: Seleção de qualidade de vídeo (360p/480p/720p/1080p/MP3), preview com thumbnail, progresso linear e performance de conversão

userStories.title: Endpoint de preview/metadata do vídeo
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a POST /api/preview endpoint that returns video metadata (title, thumbnail, available resolutions, duration) without downloading.
acceptanceCriteria: New endpoint POST /api/preview accepts { url: string } and returns { title, thumbnail_url, duration, available_qualities: number[] }
Uses yt-dlp extract_info(download=False) to get metadata
Parses available formats and returns unique resolutions from [360, 480, 720, 1080] that exist in the video
Returns error response if URL is invalid or video unavailable
Add Pydantic schemas: PreviewRequest and PreviewResponse
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added PreviewRequest/PreviewResponse schemas, POST /api/preview endpoint using yt-dlp extract_info, and extract_video_preview helper function

userStories.title: Backend - novo campo quality no DownloadRequest
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the download endpoint to accept a quality field instead of output_format so users can choose video resolution or MP3.
acceptanceCriteria: Add VideoQuality enum to models.py: '360p', '480p', '720p', '1080p', 'mp3'
Update DownloadRequest schema to accept 'quality' field (type VideoQuality, default '480p')
Keep 'output_format' field as optional for backward compatibility but mark as deprecated
Update DownloadJob model if needed to store quality
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added VideoQuality enum (360p/480p/720p/1080p/mp3) to models.py, added quality field to DownloadRequest with default 480p, kept output_format as optional deprecated field, added quality column to DownloadJob model, added quality to JobResponse

userStories.title: Backend - yt-dlp format selector por qualidade
userStories.description: As a developer, I need get_yt_dlp_options to use height-based format selectors so videos download at the selected resolution.
acceptanceCriteria: Update get_yt_dlp_options to accept quality parameter instead of output_format
For video qualities (360p/480p/720p/1080p): use format 'bestvideo[height<=N][vcodec^=avc1]+bestaudio[acodec^=mp4a]/bestvideo[height<=N]+bestaudio/best[height<=N]' where N is the resolution number
For mp3: use format 'bestaudio/best' with FFmpegExtractAudio postprocessor, codec mp3, quality 320
For video: use merge_output_format 'mp4' and FFmpegCopyStream postprocessor
Update _run_download and start_download to pass quality through
Update routes.py to pass quality from request to download service
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Replaced get_yt_dlp_options to use VideoQuality instead of OutputFormat. Video qualities use height-based format selector with avc1+mp4a preference and -c copy. MP3 uses FFmpegExtractAudio. Updated _run_download, start_download, and routes.py to pass quality. Added backward compat mapping from deprecated output_format.

userStories.title: Backend - evitar re-encoding desnecessário
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to skip FFmpeg re-encoding when the downloaded stream is already H.264+AAC compatible with MP4.
acceptanceCriteria: For video downloads: use '-c copy' in postprocessor_args when possible instead of '-c:v libx264'
Set postprocessor_args to copy streams by default: ['-c', 'copy', '-movflags', '+faststart']
Only fallback to re-encoding if copy fails (yt-dlp handles this with format selection preferring avc1+mp4a)
For MP3: if source audio is already mp3, FFmpegExtractAudio should copy without re-encoding (yt-dlp does this automatically with preferredcodec)
Add '-threads 0' to postprocessor_args for cases that need re-encoding
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added -threads 0 to postprocessor_args for both video (copystream) and MP3 (extractaudio) to optimize re-encoding fallback cases. Video already uses -c copy + +faststart from US-003. MP3 FFmpegExtractAudio auto-copies if source is already mp3.

userStories.title: Backend - progresso linear por fases proporcionais
userStories.description: As a developer, I need progress tracking to report linear progress proportional to real time in each phase instead of hardcoded jumps.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove hardcoded progress values (88%, 90%, 95%, 98%) from progress_hook and postprocessor_hook
Download phase reports 0-70% proportional to downloaded bytes
When download finishes (status='finished'), set progress to 70% instead of 88%
Conversion/postprocessor phase reports 70-95% proportional to FFmpeg progress
If no re-encoding needed (copy stream), jump from 70% to 95% quickly since it's fast
Finalization sets 95-100%
Never stay stuck at same percentage for more than 5 seconds - if no FFmpeg progress update, interpolate by incrementing 1% every 2 seconds during conversion phase
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Rescaled progress: download=0-70%, conversion=70-95%, finalization=95-100%. Added interpolation timer that increments 1% every 2s if no FFmpeg update for 5s during conversion. CopyStream jumps 70→95 naturally since it finishes fast.

userStories.title: Frontend - tipos e API client atualizados

acceptanceCriteria: Add type VideoQuality = '360p' | '480p' | '720p' | '1080p' | 'mp3' to types.ts
Add interface PreviewResponse { title: string; thumbnail_url: string; duration: number; available_qualities: number[] } to types.ts
Update DownloadRequest interface to use quality: VideoQuality instead of output_format
Update QueueItem interface to use quality: VideoQuality instead of format: OutputFormat
Add fetchPreview(url: string): Promise<PreviewResponse> function to api.ts
Remove FORMAT_OPTIONS array and FormatOption interface from types.ts
Remove OutputFormat type (no longer needed)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added VideoQuality type and PreviewResponse interface. Updated DownloadRequest to use quality field, QueueItem to use quality instead of format. Added fetchPreview to api.ts. Removed OutputFormat, FormatOption, FORMAT_OPTIONS. Updated FormatSelector to use VideoQuality with 5 quality options. Updated tests.

userStories.title: Frontend - componente de preview com thumbnail

acceptanceCriteria: Create VideoPreview component that receives PreviewResponse data and displays: thumbnail (16:9 aspect ratio), title, formatted duration
Show loading skeleton while preview is being fetched
Show error state if video is unavailable
Component appears below URL input area, above quality selector
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Created VideoPreview component with loading skeleton (animate-pulse), error state, and preview display (thumbnail 16:9, title with line-clamp-2, formatted duration). Exported from components/index.ts.

userStories.title: Frontend - radio buttons de qualidade
userStories.description: As a user, I want simple horizontal radio buttons (360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, MP3) to choose download quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Create QualitySelector component with horizontal radio buttons: 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, MP3
Default selected: 480p
Accepts availableQualities prop (number array from preview) to disable resolutions above the video's real quality
Disabled options show gray style with title tooltip 'Qualidade não disponível para este vídeo'
If no preview loaded yet, all video options are enabled
MP3 option is always enabled
Remove old FormatSelector component
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Created QualitySelector component with horizontal radio buttons (360p/480p/720p/1080p/MP3). Accepts availableQualities prop to disable resolutions above video's real quality. Disabled options show gray style with tooltip. MP3 always enabled. Removed old FormatSelector component and tests. Updated App.tsx and component index.
